title: Design HA, persistence, and geo for a critical service
intent: Checks the answer selects zone redundancy at creation with client failover handling, distinguishes persistence/backup from zone/geo resilience, and treats active geo-replication as a provisioning-time decision.
prompt: Review this reliability plan for a revenue-critical Azure Managed Redis deployment and correct it.

input_artifacts.name: reliability-plan.txt
input_artifacts.content: topology: single zone; backups: periodic export considered equivalent to zone resilience; failover: clients assume the endpoint never drops; geo: 'we will enable active geo-replication later if needed'

embedded_defects.defect: Single-zone topology with no failover handling for an availability-critical workload.
Treats export backup as a substitute for zone/geo resilience.
Assumes active geo-replication can be toggled on later rather than decided at provisioning.
